_comment: Defaults for Heath's founder-on-camera Dossie content. Every field here is a knob review.js can turn; see fix-registry.js for which finding drives which one.
cta: Follow along as we build Dossie.
_shotPlan: §4. OFF is the dossie_trial_06 failure mode (35.7s, first picture change at 27.0s). openWide:false opens TIGHT on the hook question and pulls wide for the list, which is how this would actually be cut.
_matte: OFF by default. §16 says authenticity beats polish and §1 says it must not look AI-generated; a real room is not automatically a defect. review.js turns this on via visuals.room_visible when the room is actually a problem.
_audio: Isolation runs on the FULL take before the cut (4.6s API minimum) and is kept only if it measurably beats the original. deroom EQ runs after it either way.
_music: §7 — music is OPTIONAL. Silence is acceptable. Left off; review.js asks for it only if the pacing needs it.
_denoise: denoiseStrength omitted = AUTO: 0 when Audio Isolation won the A/B (no double-denoise), 1 otherwise. review.js sets an explicit value when it hears the voice as muffled.
